name: pytorch
description: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration
one_liner: The free engine most AI companies use under the hood to build and train neural networks; it's plumbing, not a finished product.
buyer: A company that wants to train its own AI model on proprietary data rather than renting one from a vendor, but needs engineers who know PyTorch to build it.
business_use_cases: An ML consultancy builds custom computer-vision or NLP models for manufacturing or healthcare clients on top of it.
A training/bootcamp business teaches practical PyTorch skills to developers pivoting into AI roles.
A startup fine-tunes an open model with PyTorch and sells the result as a narrow, specialized API.

money_ideas.idea: Offer custom model training as a service for companies with proprietary data.
Run paid PyTorch upskilling workshops for engineering teams.

steal_this: Not a weekend product by itself — the real move is picking one specific client's dataset and shipping a small fine-tuned model as a paid API, with PyTorch doing the invisible work.
